description: This file defines the interface for the message bus in the CcspLogAgent component. It declares function prototypes for engaging with the message bus, initializing, finalizing, checking the bus, and freeing resources.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages with the message bus using specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus interface based on priority and user data.
